metadata.description: Formify e-signature and identity verification for AI agents

plugins.name: formify
plugins.description: Formify Core — for any business that needs e-signature. Build fillable PDF forms and contracts, send them for signature or publish one signing link, verify signers with BankID or an ID scan, and track what happens after sending. Not industry-specific. Spanish estate agencies should install Formify for Real Estate Agencies instead (that pack already includes Core — do not install both).

plugins.name: formify-es-real-estate
plugins.description: Formify for Real Estate Agencies (Spain) — Formify Core plus the Spanish estate-agency niche: nota de encargo, buyer/seller KYC, oferta y reserva, contrato de arras, inter-agency collaboration and key handover. Bilingual, region-correct, ready to sign. Includes the full Core skill set — do not install Formify Core as well.
